# Tax Tracker AI Guide

- Purpose: FastAPI app for federal tax + withholding + income tracking; REST routers live in [src/taxtracker/api](../src/taxtracker/api) and are mounted in [src/taxtracker/cli/app.py](../src/taxtracker/cli/app.py) without an `/api` prefix.
- Config: Central settings in [src/taxtracker/core/config.py](../src/taxtracker/core/config.py) (Pydantic Settings). Override `database_url`, `data_dir`, `api_host/api_port`, and `w4_threshold` via `.env`. `settings.get_data_file()` builds paths like `tax_brackets_2025.json`.
- Data files: Tax brackets and FICA limits live in [src/taxtracker/data](../src/taxtracker/data). Add new years via [src/taxtracker/services/data_loader.py](../src/taxtracker/services/data_loader.py) helpers (`validate_and_save_*`) which enforce required fields and year matching.
- Tax calc: [src/taxtracker/services/tax_calculator.py](../src/taxtracker/services/tax_calculator.py) caches JSON data per year, computes AGI, deduction (standard vs itemized), bracket-by-bracket federal tax, child credit, FICA, effective/marginal rates, and notes (e.g., wage base caps, non-taxable income). Use `TaxCalculationRequest`/`Response` models in [src/taxtracker/models/tax_data.py](../src/taxtracker/models/tax_data.py).
- DB-backed tax calc: [src/taxtracker/services/db_tax_calculator.py](../src/taxtracker/services/db_tax_calculator.py) aggregates YTD income via `get_ytd_summary` before calling `TaxCalculator`; uses `settings.w4_threshold` for refund/owed messaging.
- W-4 tooling: Optimizer in [src/taxtracker/services/w4_calculator.py](../src/taxtracker/services/w4_calculator.py) distributes adjustments per job and emits W-4 step guidance; withholding simulator in [src/taxtracker/services/w4_withholding.py](../src/taxtracker/services/w4_withholding.py) implements Pub 15-T percentage method per paycheck.
- Projections: [src/taxtracker/services/projections.py](../src/taxtracker/services/projections.py) projects a year or compares years using the same `TaxCalculator` pipeline plus FICA on W-2 wages only.
- Income model: SQLAlchemy models in [src/taxtracker/models/database.py](../src/taxtracker/models/database.py) cover `Employer`, `Paycheck` (pre/post-tax deductions, taxable benefits, withheld taxes, computed properties), `Retirement1099R` (no FICA), and `NonTaxableIncome`. Default DB is SQLite; tables auto-created on startup unless `skip_db_init=True`.
- Schemas: Pydantic schemas in [src/taxtracker/models/schemas.py](../src/taxtracker/models/schemas.py) use `FlexibleDate` (dateutil parsing) and `CleanDecimal` (currency cleanup). Reuse these for input validation to keep CSV/API behavior consistent.
- CRUD/services: [src/taxtracker/services/income_service.py](../src/taxtracker/services/income_service.py) owns CRUD for employers/paychecks/1099R/non-taxable and `get_ytd_summary` totals that feed tax calc and W-4 logic.
- CSV import: [src/taxtracker/services/csv_import.py](../src/taxtracker/services/csv_import.py) accepts optional column mapping; identity mapping if omitted. Creates employers on the fly when only a name is provided. Returns structured success/error counts for API responses.
- API dependencies: [src/taxtracker/api/dependencies.py](../src/taxtracker/api/dependencies.py) provides `get_db` (SessionLocal) and `get_tax_calculator`; override in tests to inject temp DB or fixture calculator.
- Routers: Taxes endpoints in [src/taxtracker/api/taxes.py](../src/taxtracker/api/taxes.py) (calculate, calculate-from-db, tax data getters). Income endpoints in [src/taxtracker/api/income.py](../src/taxtracker/api/income.py) for W-2/1099R/non-taxable CRUD and CSV import. Projections/W-4 routers follow the same pattern. Root + `/health` live in the CLI app.
- Decimal discipline: Monetary values are `Decimal` throughout; Pydantic coercion handles strings like `$1,234.56`. Avoid floats in new logic and keep conversions localized to response serialization.
- Non-taxable handling: VA/SSA/gifts recorded in `NonTaxableIncome` are excluded from tax but added to household totals and notes; 1099-R never pays FICA; Social Security wage base cap enforced in `TaxCalculator` notes.
- Data-year pitfalls: JSON must exist for requested year; tests often inject data via `TaxCalculator.set_test_data`. When adding years, ensure `standard_deductions` and `child_tax_credit` align with `FilingStatus` keys.
- Testing: Preferred command `uv run pytest tests/ -v` (fast, no file IO dependencies). Full check pipeline: `uv run ruff check src/taxtracker/`, `uv run mypy src/taxtracker/`, then `python3 verify.py` for combined checks/coverage.
- Running: Dev server via `uv run uvicorn taxtracker.cli.app:app --reload` (no `/api` prefix). API docs at `/docs`. CLI entry in `taxtracker.cli.app:main`.
- Patterns for new endpoints: depend on `get_db`/`get_tax_calculator`, return Pydantic response models (or `.to_dict()` for custom DTOs), catch domain errors (`TaxCalculationError`, `DatabaseError`, `ValidationError`) and map to HTTPException with helpful detail.
- Data_dir overrides: For tests or alternate datasets, pass `skip_db_init=True` to `create_app` and override `settings.data_dir` or `get_tax_calculator` dependency to point at fixture JSON.
- CSV/API consistency: Keep field names aligned with schema attributes; CSV import relies on identical naming when no mapping is provided.
- Guardrails: No `/api` prefix on routes; keep Year ranges within `TaxCalculationRequest` (2024-2030); FICA is computed only on W-2 wages; pension/non-taxable excluded from FICA.
